description: This Java class 'GetExistsBsonVisitor' generates MongoDB BSON objects for field existence queries, implementing the 'ExistsFieldExpressionVisitor' interface. It constructs BSON filters based on different field types and supports authorization filtering.

classes.name: GetExistsBsonVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class that creates BSON filters for existence checks on fields within MongoDB, supporting authorization filtering.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method to create a BSON filter for an ExistsFieldExpression with optional authorization IDs.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for an attribute field existence.

methods.name: visitFeature
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for a feature ID existence.

methods.name: visitFeatureIdProperty
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for a specific property of a feature ID.

methods.name: visitPointer
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for a pointer, with authorization filtering if applicable.

methods.name: visitRootLevelField
methods.description: Creates a BSON filter for a root-level field existence.

methods.name: matchKey
methods.description: Helper method to create a regex-based BSON filter with optional authorization filtering.

methods.name: escapeAndWrapExistsRegex
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string and wraps it for existence regex matching.

methods.name: escapeJavascriptRegex
methods.description: Escapes special regex characters in a string for JavaScript regex compatibility.
